page.overview:
Who is Parker Brakeston?

Parker Brakeston races for the team "N2O Cola" in the movie Cars 3. He is replaced mid-season by H.J. Hollis in the film.

Parker competes in the 2016 Piston Cup season. During the mid-season of that year, Jackson Storm made his debut which caused sponsors to fire veteran racers and replace them with Next-Generation race cars, that had better achievements on the tracks. Due to this, Parker was forced to stop competing in the Piston Cup and N2O Cola replaced him with a next-generation rookie racer named H.J. Hollis.
